security_procurement.zh: 《人工智能运行政策》（2026年5月28日生效），规范学校AI采购、风险管理及禁止性AI实践。

title.en: Check the rules for your work

scope.en: Subject coordinators set assessment AI permissions; UTS sign-in for Microsoft Copilot provides commercial data protection for learning support but never grants assignment permission, and AI Operations Policy (effective 28 May 2026) governs institutional operations.
scope.zh: 课程协调员（Subject Coordinator）设定考核作业的AI使用许可；使用UTS账号登录Microsoft Copilot可在学习辅助中获得商业数据保护，但绝不等于作业许可，校级《人工智能运行政策》（2026年5月28日生效）规范学校AI治理。

do.en: Check subject coordinator guidance before using GenAI for assessed work.
do.zh: 在考核作业中使用AI前核对课程协调员要求。

do.en: Acknowledge GenAI content appropriately even when permitted.
do.zh: 即使允许使用，也应适当披露或引用。

do.en: Use UTS sign-in for the described protected Copilot experience.
do.zh: 使用UTS账号登录以取得指南所述受保护Copilot。

dont.en: Do not assume institutionally available tools are permitted in assignments.
dont.zh: 不要把学校提供工具等同于作业许可。

dont.en: UTS guidance advises not entering personal details, confidential data or text from assignments or research into GenAI.
dont.zh: UTS指南建议不要向生成式AI输入个人信息、保密数据，或来自作业与研究的文本。

coursework.en: Course permission is determined by subject coordinator; allowed AI material still needs acknowledgement.
coursework.zh: 课程协调员确定许可，允许使用仍须适当说明。
coursework.meaningEn: UTS Library / study guidance; check subject outlines and subject coordinator instructions before using GenAI in assessed work.
coursework.meaningZh: UTS图书馆与学习指引；在考核作业中使用生成式AI前，必须核对课程大纲及课程协调员要求。

exams.zh: 尚未独立核实考试专用AI授权规则。
exams.meaningEn: No separate exam-specific operative source was verified in this bundle; check subject and exam instructions.
exams.meaningZh: 本批资料未单独核实专门的考试AI实施细则；请以具体课程大纲和考试说明为准。

disclosure.en: Students must acknowledge AI use in assessments; verbatim generation requires instructor direction.
disclosure.zh: 评估中须说明AI使用；直接生成考核原文须教师指示。
disclosure.meaningEn: UTS Library study guidance requiring appropriate acknowledgement or citation whenever GenAI use is permitted in an assessment.
disclosure.meaningZh: UTS图书馆学习指引，要求在考核允许使用生成式AI时仍须按规定适当披露或引用。

privacy_data.en: Library advises not to input personal, confidential, assignment or research text into GenAI.
privacy_data.zh: 图书馆建议不要将个人、保密、作业及研究文本输入生成式AI。
privacy_data.meaningEn: UTS student GenAI privacy guidance; do not upload personal, confidential, or unpublished assignment/research text into public GenAI tools.
privacy_data.meaningZh: UTS学生生成式AI隐私指引；切勿向公共生成式AI工具上传个人、机密或未发表的作业及科研文本。

approved_tools.en: Library lists UTS-signed-in Copilot and catalogue Research Assistant; no blanket assessment authorization.
approved_tools.zh: 图书馆列有UTS登录版Copilot和目录研究助手；不构成统一考核授权。
approved_tools.meaningEn: UTS GenAI tools guidance (Microsoft Copilot with UTS sign-in as preferred learning tool); tool availability does not authorize assignment use.
approved_tools.meaningZh: UTS生成式AI工具指引（推荐使用UTS账号登录Microsoft Copilot辅助学习）；工具可访问不等于作业获准使用。

research_publication.en: Research guidance calls for confidentiality and licence checks; publication rules need further verification.
research_publication.zh: 科研指南要求保密和许可核查；发表规定尚需核实。
research_publication.meaningEn: Use of AI in Research Guidelines; researchers remain accountable for integrity, confidentiality, and publisher disclosure rules.
research_publication.meaningZh: 《科研中使用AI指南》；研究人员须对学术诚信、数据保密及期刊出版披露要求承担责任。

academic_integrity.en: Unallowed AI assignment content is considered misconduct in UTS Library guidance.
academic_integrity.zh: 图书馆指南将未经许可的AI作业内容视为不端。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: UTS academic integrity guidance on unpermitted AI use; complete current Student Rules Section 16 misconduct clauses and appeal windows remain unverified.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: UTS关于未经许可使用AI的学术诚信指引；现行《学生规则》第16节完整违纪条款与申诉期限尚待核实。

teaching_guidance.en: Faculty-facing subject guidance recommends discipline-sensitive AI instructions and student acknowledgement.
teaching_guidance.zh: 面向教师的指南要求结合学科制定指引并告知学生披露要求。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Subject-level guidance on documenting and acknowledging permitted GenAI use in learning and assessment.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 课程层面的教学与学习指引，指导学生记录并规范披露获准使用的生成式AI辅助。

security_procurement.en: Institutional AI system lifecycle follows a six-stage process; research is separately governed.
security_procurement.zh: 机构AI系统须走六阶段程序；研究另行管理。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Artificial Intelligence Operations Policy (effective 28 May 2026) governing institutional procurement, risk management, and prohibited AI practices.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 《人工智能运行政策》（2026年5月28日生效），规范学校AI采购、风险管理及禁止性AI实践。
